messages:
rachel (partnerships): Heads up team  NVIDIA Marketplace review just asked for our compliance bundle + a hardware supply-chain attestation for the reference appliance listing. They specifically want firmware hashes, SBAT/secure-boot attestation, SOC2, and the external pentest. Deadline: Fri EOD PT. Can @danny and @yvonne take point on the redaction/attestation pieces? Link to portal: https://nvidia/marketplace/partner-upload :point_up:
danny (security): Ill take the pentest/technical attestation. Clarify: do they want full binary firmware images or just signed hashes and a verification checklist? Also we need to know whether firmware was part of the original pentest scope.
yvonne (legal): Ill confirm vendor sharing permissions and check for any export-control language around firmware. If the firmware contains third-party copyrighted blobs we may need vendor consent before upload.
mark (infra): We have SOC2 in the vault: s3://redwood-compliance/2025/soc2_type_ii_2025.pdf. I can stage firmware hashes CSV and the secure-boot attestations in a partners bucket. Will follow the portal filename rules (lowercase, underscores).
supplychain-bot: New evidence bucket created: s3://partners/nvidia-evidence-1778881234. Use `/grant partners/nvidia-evidence-1778881234 danny@redwood.com yvonne@redwood.com mark@redwood.com rachel@redwood.com` to grant access.
danny (security): Thanks bot. Rachel  can you paste the exact checklist snippet they sent? Want to make sure we include the right artifacts and naming convention.
rachel (partnerships): They sent this:
```
- soc2_type_ii_2025.pdf
- pentest_external_2025_redacted.pdf
- firmware_hashes_2025.csv
- secureboot_attestation_2025.pdf
- supply_chain_attestation_vendors.pdf
- in_scope_hosts.csv
- contact_sheet_security.csv
```
They also ask for the primary security contact and the firmware signing CA cert if available.
danny (security): Ok. If the pentest didn't include firmware we should provide a signed engineering attestation and the firmware hash list + reproduction steps for validation. I'll draft `firmware_validation_steps.md` showing how to verify hashes and signatures.
yvonne (legal): I'll draft a short vendor permission letter template for any third-party blobs and attach `vendor_permission_template.docx`. Also will check whether the marketplace requires the CA cert to be PEM or DER.
mark (infra): Ill generate `firmware_hashes_2025.csv` with columns: `image_name,sha256,build_id,release_date,signer`. ETA 3 hours. Will also add `secureboot_attestation_2025.pdf` exported from our firmware signing service.
supplychain-bot: Note: bucket policy currently blocks public-read. Presigned links expire in 7 days by default.
danny (security): Good. Also propose we include `supply_chain_risk_summary.md` that lists vendor SOC/ISO attestations and firmware provenance. That helps the reviewer quickly triage risk questions.
rachel (partnerships): Nice idea. That file will probably speed approval. @yvonne  can you confirm any redaction needs for firmware metadata?
yvonne (legal): Redact any customer-specific hostnames or internal build server URLs. Firmware build IDs are fine. If vendor blobs include clear customer identifiers we must mask those.
danny (security): I'll run a quick static scan of firmware metadata for PII then sign off. If we need to provide only attestation instead of full firmware images we'll produce `firmware_attestation_signed.pdf` signed by our CTO.
mark (infra): Uploading draft artifacts to the bucket now. Filenames follow the checklist. Will paste presigned links after grant is applied.
rachel (partnerships): Timeline: aim to upload midday tomorrow so I can submit before EOD. If NVIDIA asks for the CA cert format, we can provide both PEM and DER.
danny (security): Also note: portal reviewers sometimes ask for a CVE backlog for firmware components. I'll compile `firmware_cve_backlog.csv` if they request.
yvonne (legal): Sent vendor permission email template to ShieldWave/BootKey and cc'd @rachel. If vendors require an NDA, use our marketplace NDA link: https://redwood/legal/marketplace-nda.
supplychain-bot: Grant executed for danny@redwood.com and mark@redwood.com. Pending approval for yvonne@redwood.com (manual).
rachel (partnerships): Thanks everyone. This thread is the canonical place for uploads and ticket updates. If NVIDIA gives any exceptions (e.g., accept signed attestation instead of raw firmware) Ill post here and route approvals. :rocket:
